proposals.title: Still and quick
proposals.direction: Near-native: 80 ms hover; the space marker fades out and back at the new place (90 ms each), no travel; the panel arrives as one piece (140 ms fade, 4 px drop) and leaves in 100 ms; room switch is the spec's 0.45 s crossfade.

proposals.title: Gliding marker
proposals.direction: One thing travels: underline and dot glide to the new space (240 ms, soft ease-out). The panel grows out of the field (a widening clip, 220 ms) and folds back into it (160 ms). Field hover lifts its accent edge 45 % to 70 %. Room switch 0.45 s.

proposals.title: The lantern relights
proposals.direction: Motion from the flame: the accent dot re-lights at the new space (grows with a brief glow, 320 ms); the panel's rows rise 22 ms apart and the field's edge breathes once; on a room switch the flame changes first (200 ms), the room follows 120 ms later in 0.45 s.
